title: Smart Agent
tagline: Smart agent - EVM stack an AI image generator app, based on LLM models.
description:
Galadriel is built on a parallel-execution EVM stack which enables high throughput and low latency while providing a familiar experience to Solidity developers. It brings AI inference on-chain in a low-cost, low-latency manner through teeML (Trusted Execution Environment Machine Learning) which allows querying open and closed-source LLM models in a verifiable way.
* all of the functionality in the stack is not live as Galadriel is in an early devnet stage.
how_its_made:
* Using Galadriel Devnet which enables developers to build AI apps and agents like smart contracts, decentralized and on-chain.
- git clone https://github.com/bild96/smart-agent
- cd smart-agent/contracts
- npm install
- npm run callQuickstart
* It brings AI inference on-chain in a low-cost, low-latency manner through teeML (Trusted Execution Environment Machine Learning) which allows querying open and closed-source LLM models in a verifiable way.
